title: A supervised step whose worker is still working past the task timeout is cut, its task ended cancelled: the step is read as timed out, never reviewed nor run again, and the chain stops there
notes: Python: tests/orchestration/test_worker_delegation_bound.py test_a_worker_past_its_bound_is_cut_and_the_call_answers_once (the supervised-sequential door). orchestration/strategies/supervisor/supervised.py _run_supervised_sequential (a delegation not ok breaks before the review), _step_ended (its rendered result: the timeout's text). The analyst's model waits at a gate no step opens. The same timeout also bounds the supervisor's task-framing pass; 2 s leaves room for that successful turn and store I/O while the analyst remains held (RMK-1331).
